categories.name: Sustainable Products
categories.short: Bio-degradable, recyclable and eco-friendly material options developed around your specification.

products.name: Stretch Film — Bio-Degradable
products.shortDescription: High-cling wrapping film in biodegradable / oxo-biodegradable grades that binds pallets and loose loads into one stable, protected unit.
products.fullDescription: Stretch film is used to wrap and stabilise palletised loads during storage and transit, protecting goods from dust, moisture and load shift. Our bio-degradable grade gives you the same secure, tear-resistant hold you expect from a high-cling film, for businesses that want to make a more responsible material choice without changing the way they wrap.
features: High cling for a secure, tight hold
Tear resistance during wrapping and handling
benefits: Keeps loads together as a single unit from warehouse floor to customer's door
Reduces load shift and handling damage in transit
Supports your sustainability direction with a responsible film choice

products.name: Stretch Film — Non Bio-Degradable
products.shortDescription: Conventional LLDPE high-cling stretch film for dependable pallet wrapping and load stabilisation.
products.fullDescription: Our conventional LLDPE stretch film wraps and stabilises palletised loads during storage and transit. It binds pallets and loose loads into a stable, protected unit, resisting tears and holding securely while keeping dust and moisture out.
benefits: Proven, dependable performance for everyday wrapping
Helps prevent load shift and product damage
Suits manual and high-volume wrapping operations

products.name: Honeycomb Pallets
products.shortDescription: Lightweight, high-strength paper honeycomb pallets — a recyclable alternative to wood for export shipments.
products.fullDescription: Paper honeycomb panels are engineered as a lightweight, high-strength, fully recyclable alternative to wood and foam. Honeycomb pallets carry loads while keeping shipping weight down, making them well suited to export consignments.

products.name: Honeycomb Boxes
products.shortDescription: Shipping boxes built from recyclable paper honeycomb for shock-absorbing, lightweight protection.
products.fullDescription: Honeycomb boxes use a paper-based cellular structure to absorb shock while remaining light. They protect fragile goods such as glassware, ceramics and electronics through storage, handling and transport.
benefits: Protects fragile items with less material weight
Replaces foam in many packaging formats

products.name: Honeycomb Die Cuts
products.shortDescription: Die-cut paper honeycomb shapes for cushioning, void filling and box lining.
products.fullDescription: Die-cut honeycomb pieces are shaped to cradle products, fill voids and line boxes. The flexible paper cell structure absorbs impact while remaining fully paper-based.
benefits: Holds products in place inside the box

products.name: Honeycomb Partitions
products.shortDescription: Internal honeycomb partitions that separate and protect items within a single shipment.
products.fullDescription: Honeycomb partitions divide cartons into protected compartments so items don't touch during transit. They are light, rigid and made from recyclable paper honeycomb.

products.name: Honeycomb Displays
products.shortDescription: Retail and exhibition displays built from rigid, recyclable paper honeycomb board.
products.fullDescription: Honeycomb display units combine rigidity with low weight, making them easy to transport and assemble for retail and exhibition use, with a recyclable paper-based build.

products.name: Honeycomb Doors
products.shortDescription: Paper honeycomb door cores — a lightweight, high-strength core material.
products.fullDescription: Paper honeycomb is used as a door core material, providing a lightweight, high-strength structure inside door panels.

products.name: Honeycomb Wrap / Protective Honeycomb
products.shortDescription: Paper-based cellular wrap for cushioning, product wrapping and void filling.
products.fullDescription: Recyclable honeycomb wrap is a paper-based cellular packaging material used for cushioning, void filling and box lining. Its flexible structure wraps around products to protect against impact.

products.name: 3 Ply Carton Boxes
products.shortDescription: Light-duty corrugated shipping cartons, custom sized and printed to your product dimensions.
products.fullDescription: 3-ply corrugated cartons are light-duty shipping boxes for products that need dependable protection without excess material. They are custom sized and can be printed to exact product dimensions — right-sizing that helps reduce unnecessary material and void fill.
benefits: Right-sized packaging reduces material and freight volume
Printable for branding and handling information

products.name: 5 Ply Carton Boxes
products.shortDescription: Heavy-duty corrugated cartons for heavier goods, stacking and long-distance transport.
products.fullDescription: 5-ply corrugated cartons provide a heavy-duty construction for heavier products, stacked storage and long-distance transport. Custom sized and printed to your product's exact dimensions.
benefits: Holds up to stacking in storage and transit

products.name: Plastic Tapes (BOPP)
products.shortDescription: BOPP plastic tapes for carton sealing and bundling — clear, coloured and printed.
products.fullDescription: BOPP plastic tapes seal and bundle cartons securely for storage and dispatch. Available in clear, coloured and printed variants for identification and branding.

products.name: Paper Tapes
products.shortDescription: Reinforced kraft paper tapes for carton sealing, with eco-friendly variants.
products.fullDescription: Reinforced kraft paper tapes seal and bundle cartons and are available in eco-friendly variants for businesses moving away from plastic tape.

products.name: Customized Industrial Foams
products.shortDescription: Engineered foam inserts and sheets, CNC die-cut to your product's geometry.
products.fullDescription: Engineered foam inserts and sheets are CNC die-cut to match product geometry, protecting sensitive, heavy or high-value items from shock and vibration during transit.
benefits: Holds each item exactly in place

products.name: Bubble Wrap
products.shortDescription: Air-cushioned polyethylene wrap for surface protection and shock absorption, including anti-static grades.
products.fullDescription: Bubble wrap is an air-cushioned polyethylene wrap used for surface protection and shock absorption. It is available in multiple bubble sizes and film thicknesses, including anti-static grades for electronics.

products.name: Industrial Sticker Printing
products.shortDescription: Custom-printed labels and stickers for identification, handling instructions, barcoding and branding.
products.fullDescription: Custom-printed labels and stickers for product identification, handling instructions, barcoding and branding across cartons, pallets and components.
benefits: Clear identification across the supply chain

variants.name: Vinyl Stickers
variants.text: Durable, weather- and abrasion-resistant stickers for outdoor, industrial or long-duration use. Resist moisture, UV exposure and rough handling — ideal for equipment labelling, pallet tagging and outdoor signage.

variants.name: Paper Stickers
variants.text: Cost-effective stickers for short-term or indoor use such as carton labelling, batch codes and general identification. Printable in bulk with sharp text and barcode clarity; not suited for moisture or outdoor exposure.

variants.name: Tamper-Proof Stickers
variants.text: Security labels that visibly show "VOID" or fracture when peeled, used to seal cartons, containers or products against unauthorised opening. Essential for export shipments and high-value product protection.

products.name: Recyclable Banners
products.shortDescription: Printed banners and signage on recyclable, PVC-free substrates — plus flex, cloth and UV print options.
products.fullDescription: Printed banners and signage on recyclable, PVC-free substrates for factory signage, safety communication and branding, alongside standard flex, cloth and UV print options so you can choose by duration, budget and sustainability goals.

variants.name: Normal Flex
variants.text: Standard PVC flex banners offering vivid, high-resolution printing at low cost for short-to-medium duration signage, promotional displays and factory announcements.

variants.name: Cloth Banner
variants.text: Fabric-based banners (polyester or canvas) with a premium, wrinkle-resistant finish and good colour depth. Lightweight and foldable — used for exhibitions, backdrops and reusable signage.

variants.name: Eco-Friendly Cloth Line Banner
variants.text: Banners made from recycled or biodegradable fabric, printed with low-impact inks as a sustainable alternative to PVC flex, while retaining cloth-banner durability.

variants.name: UV Print
variants.text: Direct UV-curable printing on rigid or flexible substrates, producing scratch-resistant, fade-resistant, high-definition output without lamination.

products.name: Sun Board with Printing
products.shortDescription: Lightweight rigid PVC foam boards with high-resolution UV printing, cut to any shape.
products.fullDescription: Lightweight, rigid PVC foam boards custom printed for point-of-sale displays, factory signage and indoor branding panels. Available in multiple thicknesses with high-resolution UV printing, cut to any shape.

products.name: Eco-Friendly Material Printing
products.shortDescription: Printing on biodegradable and recycled substrates — kraft paper, recycled board and bio-films.
products.fullDescription: Printing services on biodegradable and recycled substrates — kraft paper, recycled board and bio-films — for brands prioritising sustainable packaging, using soy- or water-based inks on request.
features: Soy- or water-based inks on request
benefits: Aligns printed materials with your sustainability goals

Customisation: Soy- or water-based inks on request

products.name: Display Boards
products.shortDescription: Custom point-of-sale and instructional display boards and stands, in foldable and knock-down formats.
products.fullDescription: Custom point-of-sale and instructional display boards or stands for retail, factory floor and exhibition use, available in foldable and knock-down formats.
benefits: Easy to transport and set up

products.name: Industrial Gloves
products.shortDescription: Hand protection across cotton, nitrile-coated and cut-resistant grades, selected by task.
products.fullDescription: Hand protection across cotton, nitrile-coated and cut-resistant grades, selected by task — general handling, wet-grip packing lines, or sharp-edge material handling such as metal sheets or die-cut boards.

products.name: Safety Helmets
products.shortDescription: ISI-marked industrial safety helmets with colour codes and adjustable ratchet fit.
products.fullDescription: ISI-marked industrial safety helmets protecting against impact and falling objects on the shop floor and warehouse. Available in multiple colour codes for role/department identification, with adjustable ratchet fit for all-day wear.

products.name: Reflective Jackets
products.shortDescription: High-visibility jackets with reflective strips for shop-floor, warehouse and loading-bay personnel.
products.fullDescription: High-visibility jackets with reflective strips for shop-floor, warehouse and loading-bay personnel, improving visibility around moving equipment and vehicles — particularly critical in low-light dispatch areas and night-shift operations.

products.name: Masks
products.shortDescription: Dust and particulate protection masks in disposable and reusable filter variants.
products.fullDescription: Dust and particulate protection masks for workers in cutting, foam-processing or high-dust packaging environments, available in disposable and reusable filter variants.

products.name: Safety Glasses
products.shortDescription: Safety goggles and protective eyewear with anti-fog and scratch-resistant options.
products.fullDescription: Safety goggles and protective eyewear shielding against dust, debris and splashes during cutting, die-cutting and material-handling operations, with anti-fog and scratch-resistant options.

products.name: Safety Shoes
products.shortDescription: Steel-toe or composite-toe industrial footwear for factory and warehouse floors.
products.fullDescription: Steel-toe or composite-toe industrial footwear protecting against crush injuries, punctures and slips on factory floors — a baseline PPE requirement for warehouse and shop-floor compliance.

products.name: Thermal Rolls
products.shortDescription: Thermal printer rolls for barcode printers, weighing scales and billing/POS systems.
products.fullDescription: Thermal printer rolls for barcode printers, weighing scales and billing/POS systems, supplied in standard and premium paper grades for warehouse and dispatch operations.
features: For barcode printers and weighing scales
benefits: Keeps billing and dispatch desks running

products.name: Other Industry Stationeries
products.shortDescription: Packing-line and warehouse consumables — cutters, markers, strapping tools and measuring equipment.
products.fullDescription: General packing-line and warehouse consumables — cutters, markers, strapping tools and measuring equipment — supplied as part of a bundled packaging contract. Tell us what your line uses and we will add it to your supply.
benefits: One supplier for packaging and consumables

products.name: Other Recyclable & Bio-Degradable Products
products.shortDescription: Compostable pouches, bio-based void-fill and recycled strapping, built to client specification.
products.fullDescription: Additional sustainable materials developed on request — compostable pouches, bio-based void-fill and recycled strapping — built to client specification as part of end-to-end eco-packaging solutions.
